name: Epidemic Sound
description: Bring pro music and sound effects into your Claude workflow. Search by mood, BPM, genre, or reference track. Adapt any track to a custom duration. Everything is owned by Epidemic Sound and licensed globally, so what you use is cleared to publish across YouTube, TikTok, podcasts, ads, and brand films depending on your subscription. Trusted by 70% of the top 300 US YouTube channels and by enterprise teams at Coca-Cola, Apple, Nasdaq, and Premier League.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Epidemic Sound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Epidemic Sound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.epidemicsound.com/a/mcp-service/listed/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Epidemic Sound MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Epidemic Sound provides these MCP tools: DownloadRecording, DownloadRecordingEdit, DownloadSoundEffect, EditRecording, PollEditRecordingJob, SearchExternalReferences, SearchRecordings, SearchSimilarToRecording, SearchSimilarToSoundEffect, and SearchSoundEffects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Epidemic Sound?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Epidemic Sound in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does Epidemic Sound MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Epidemic Sound requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Epidemic Sound is developed by Epidemic Sound. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
